description: This Java class 'ModelServiceReader' reads and parses XML service descriptor files in the Apache OFBiz framework. It processes service definitions, including attributes, permissions, notifications, auto-attributes, overrides, and related configurations to construct 'ModelService' objects for use within the framework.

classes.name: ModelServiceReader
classes.description: A class responsible for reading, parsing, and constructing service models from XML files or resources, supporting both URL-based and resource loader-based approaches in Apache OFBiz.

methods.name: getModelServiceMap
methods.description: Factory methods to create a map of service models from either a URL or a resource handler.

methods.name: getModelServices
methods.description: Parses the XML document to extract service definitions and constructs a map of 'ModelService' objects.

methods.name: createModelService
methods.description: Creates a 'ModelService' object from a given XML 'service' element, setting its properties and associated configurations.

methods.name: createCDATADef
methods.description: Extracts CDATA content within specified tags from XML elements.

methods.name: createNotification
methods.description: Adds notification configurations to a service from XML definition.

methods.name: createServicePermission
methods.description: Constructs a 'ModelPermission' instance based on XML permission element.

methods.name: createAloneServicePermission
methods.description: Adds permission service data to a 'ModelService' if defined in XML.

methods.name: createPermGroups
methods.description: Constructs permission groups for a service based on XML definitions.

methods.name: createGroupPermissions
methods.description: Creates individual permissions within a permission group.

methods.name: createGroupDefs
methods.description: Creates internal group definitions for a service, if specified.

methods.name: createImplDefs
methods.description: Adds interface implementations to the service.

methods.name: createAutoAttrDefs
methods.description: Creates auto-attribute definitions for a service based on entity fields.

methods.name: createAutoAttrDef
methods.description: Creates a single auto-attribute parameter based on entity fields and XML configuration.

methods.name: createAttrDefs
methods.description: Defines attribute parameters for a service, including defaults and standard params.

methods.name: createAttrDef
methods.description: Creates a parameter definition for an attribute based on XML element.

methods.name: createOverrideDefs
methods.description: Handles overridden parameter definitions for a service.

methods.name: createDeprecated
methods.description: Marks a service as deprecated if specified.

methods.name: addValidators
methods.description: Attaches validation rules to a parameter based on XML configuration.

methods.name: getDocument
methods.description: Reads and parses an XML document from a URL.
